description: Creates a downloadable CSV of properties or property-owner contacts matching locations and filters. Defaults to owner contact rows (`contact_audience=owners`, `anchor=person`) with names, phones, emails, and property addresses. `contact_audience=none` or `anchor=property` produces property rows without contacts. Exported records can consume credits.

active_phones_only.description: Only include phone numbers with active reported phone activity

anchor.description: default: person for property-owner contact rows

contact_audience.description: default: owners; "none" creates a property-only export

fields.description: Additional fields to include. Omit for the owner-contact default fields.

items.description: Search area. Locations OR together across the array.

code.description: state (2-letter), county (5-digit FIPS), city (place ID), or zip_code

require_email.description: Only include contacts with an email address

require_phone.description: Only include contacts with a phone number

scrub_dnc.description: Exclude contacts on the Do Not Call registry

name: dealmachine_property_export
